attchmntText: Modi Rubber Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Meeting held on November 13, 2026.
voiceSummary: Modi Rubber Limited announced the outcome of its Board Meeting held on 13th November 2026. The Board approved the unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half-year ended on 30th September 2026, accompanied by a limited review report. The Board also reviewed the financial statements of wholly owned subsidiaries, joint ventures, and associated companies for the quarter ended 30th September 2026. Additionally, the Board considered the statement of investments and related party transactions made between 1st July 2026 and 30th September 2026. The meeting commenced at 12:00 PM and concluded at 12:45 PM.

attchmntText: Modi Rubber Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Modi Rubber Limited filed its unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, and the year-to-date period from April 1, 2026, to September 30, 2026. P N A M & Co. LLP, Chartered Accountants, issued independent auditor’s review reports on November 13, 2026. The auditors stated that nothing came to their attention to suggest the statements contain material misstatements or fail to disclose required information under SEBI Listing Regulations. The consolidated results include the group’s share of net profit of Rs. 266.94 lacs for the quarter and Rs. 787.01 lacs for the year-to-date period from joint ventures and associates. Standalone results show a loss before tax of Rs. 455.30 lacs for the quarter and Rs. 720.24 lacs for the year-to-date period. Total assets stood at Rs. 42,740.87 lacs as of September 30, 2026.
